samples_auto_sync_details.notes: Auto-sync only triggers when status CHANGES to a sample status. Existing items with sample status won't be synced unless their status is changed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Samples Library Auto-Sync feature is WORKING. When an item's status is changed to 'ORDER SAMPLES', 'SAMPLES ORDERED', or 'ENTER INTO HOUZZ & ORDER SAMPLE', the item is automatically added to the Samples collection (db.samples) and appears in the Samples Library tab. The config.js file at /app/frontend/public/config.js controls the backend URL - for preview it should point to https://edit-scraped-data.preview.emergentagent.com, for production it should point to https://app.estdesignco.com. Test data was created: TEST_Wheeler Ridge project with items.
